'''Okko''', stylized as the '''Great Okko''', was the chief of a tribe of [[Ysanna/Legends|Ysanna]] on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] and was regarded as the mightiest [[Force-sensitive/Legends|force user]] in his people's history. He participated in the [[Skirmish on Ossus|Battle of Ossus]]. He was the [[Parent/Legends|father]] of [[Jem Ysanna|Jem]] and [[Rayf Ysanna]].<ref name="DE II 3">[[Dark Empire II 3|''Dark Empire II'' 3]]</ref> Okko's great-grandfather rediscovered the [[Great Jedi Library/Legends|Great Jedi Library]] of Ossus, but kept it a family secret out of fear of looters.<ref name="DE II 4">[[Dark Empire II 4|''Dark Empire II'' 4]]</ref>

After the battle, Okko and two other Ysanna [[Shaman/Legends|shamans]] were trapped in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] by the forces of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], who was seeking to use the tribe as a means to halt the genetic decay of his last [[Cloning/Legends|clone]]. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] soon discovered he was taken to [[Vjun/Legends|Vjun]] to the clone laboratory at [[Bast Castle]], but unfortunately, the carbon slabs did not have the controls so he hoped to confront the Emperor and free him.<ref name="EE 1">[[Empire's End 1|''Empire's End'' 1]]</ref> But luck was not with Okko as Palpatine was killed before he could tell the secret to opening the slabs.<ref name="EE 2">[[Empire's End 2|''Empire's End'' 2]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[Dark Empire II (audio drama)|audio drama]] [[Star Wars: Empire's End|adaptations]] of ''[[Star Wars: Dark Empire II]]'' and [[Empire's End (audio drama)|''Empire's End'']], Okko was voiced by [[John Cygan]].
